limitations: The validation covers the ranked first predecessor path of the initial call_id=1 DP chaining call. It does not classify later chains or the long-join RMQ call. RMQ receives a compacted and re-sorted anchor array whose indices cannot be joined to the pre-DP SD records.

The validator independently scans the reference for every overlapping exact source occurrence and checks every declared copy slice. Path identity then uses those verified intervals, the expected strand, and a conservative diagonal tolerance equal to all realized inserted and deleted bases plus any explicit extra tolerance.

The experiment mode sorts equal-score candidate ends by increasing anchor index before minimap2 backtracks them in reverse order. This implements the BioSeqDB tie rule but can change tied-chain extraction relative to an uninstrumented minimap2 run. The script does not independently recompute minimizers or chaining scores.

ranked_first_path.start_rule: maximum score, then maximum anchor-array position on ties

run_l_definition: j >= L-1 and c <= n-L and all(p[j-u] == j-u-1 for u in [0,L))

seed_coordinate_join.array_order_basis: SD records are printed from a[] immediately before a[] is passed to the chaining implementation that emits the indexed P rows

validator.description: independent reconstruction from minimap2 f/p/z dumps joined to pre-chaining SD anchor coordinates
